answer: A Code contribution merged by two maintainers backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lone meadow proves nothing about craft; only the reviewed record counts. When the sonnet settles over the vertex, the work holds because every task carried its own review.
